Introduced by Wei Wuzhi, he was received the same day and made Commandant, carriage companion to the king, and overseer of discipline in the army. The generals erupted: why should a fresh defector from Chu — one whose quality nobody knew — ride in the king's own carriage and supervise men older and senior to himself?
